source.reason: GW's guide gives Ghazghkull Thraka's Makari a 25mm base. In 11th edition Makari is no model of the unit: the datasheet's ability "Makari, Hoist Dat Banner!" places a Makari token, and New Recruit lists the unit as "1x Ghazghkull Thraka". (A Makari model used as that token would stand on 25mm.)

source.implements: the bases gate step: every model row’s base equals GW’s base size guide as the app writes it; GW’s rows for some models of a unit met by a stats row, a models line (baseWith for wargear) or an absent declaration; declarations in verify/deviations-bases.json

finding a model’s row in GW’s base size guide (lookup: model rows of a unit or of “A/B” units, by name, plural, words, or a model name that is part of the row’s (Nob of Boss Nob), else null, never the unit’s own row; a model’s own exact name first; a model row of another unit) and a declared base (declared, from verify/deviations-bases.json; throws when a declared guide row is missing); both used by verify/from-json.js
a list written from a New Recruit JSON export takes a declared base (verify/deviations-bases.json), else GW’s guide row (the corrected lookup), else Wahapedia’s (listed to check)
Bases & proxies: a models line’s base is its stats row’s, or the stats row’s baseWith for wargear the line carries (GW’s base size guide rows for wargear: Transuranic Arquebus)
